entities.name: Hussein ibn Nasser
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hussein ibn Nasser Sharif was a Jordanian prince and statesman who served as the 16th Prime Minister of Jordan from 1963 to 1964, and again in 1967 during the reign of his great-grandnephew Hussein. He previously served as ambassador to Spain and Turkey.
